evidence.experimental_conditions: FITC sensitization: occlusive application for 24 h on days 1 and 8, re-exposure on day 15; ear thickness measured at 24 h post-challenge; mice: 8-12 week old TGM3-/- C57BL/6 mice.
evidence.support_text: Fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC) was used in a mouse ear swelling test on TGM3 knockout (TGM3-/-) and wild-type C57BL/6 mice. Mice were sensitized by 24 h occlusive application of FITC on days 1 and 8, re-exposed on day 15, and ear thickness was measured at 24 h and 48 h. In TGM3-/- mice (n=38), mean ear thickening was 13.98% at 24 h, and 14/38 (36%) exhibited significant (>20%) ear thickening. This indicates that FITC induces a positive skin sensitization response in the context of a damaged skin barrier.

evidence.experimental_conditions: Reaction of electrochemically oxidized PPD with human hemoglobin, followed by LC-MS analysis and deconvolution. α-chain analyzed.
evidence.support_text: The authors report that treatment of Hb with EC-oxidized allergen leads to adduct formation with the α-chain. Deconvolution reveals a signal at 15232.0 Da, which is assigned to monomeric PPD (PPQD) being bound to the Cys-104 function. The calculated average molecular mass (15232.3 Da) correlates well.

evidence.experimental_conditions: Reaction of electrochemically oxidized PPD with human hemoglobin, followed by LC-MS analysis and deconvolution. β-chain analyzed.
evidence.support_text: The authors state that for the Hb β-chain, the deconvoluted neutral mass of 15969.9 Da (mass increase of 104.4 Da) can unambiguously be assigned to a reaction of only one thiol function with PPQD, though it is not possible to predict which Cys residue (Cys-93 or Cys-112) is attached.

evidence.experimental_conditions: Aniline oxidized at constant potential on boron-doped diamond electrode; reaction with HSA; analysis by LC-ESI-ToF-MS
evidence.support_text: Aniline was oxidized at a constant potential and then allowed to react with human serum albumin (HSA). Analysis by liquid chromatography coupled to ESI-ToF-MS showed that aniline adducts with HSA were successfully generated and identified.
